description: Presidential Secretariat - Notify the National Audit Act No. 19 of 2018 order under section 1(2), this order operation 01, August 2018
reasoning: This gazette content is an order by the President bringing specific parts of the National Audit Act, No. 19 of 2018 into operation. It deals with the implementation of a law (legal/regulatory matter) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. While it names the President, this is in his capacity as the authority executing the law, and the notice does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make a personnel appointment.
